front_prompt: Define 'Map' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Map: A top-view representation or drawing of a specific geographic area on a flat surface using scale, direction, and symbols.

front_prompt: Define 'Atlas' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Atlas: A bound book or collection of various types of maps.

front_prompt: Define 'Globe' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Globe: A three-dimensional spherical model of the Earth that preserves the accurate shape of landmasses and oceans.

front_prompt: Define 'Scale' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Scale: The ratio between a distance measured on a map and the corresponding actual distance on the ground.

front_prompt: Define 'Cardinal Directions' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Cardinal Directions: The four main directional points: North (N), East (E), South (S), and West (W).

front_prompt: Define 'Intermediate Directions' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Intermediate Directions: The four directions located halfway between cardinal points: Northeast (NE), Southeast (SE), Southwest (SW), and Northwest (NW).

front_prompt: Define 'Parallels of Latitude' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Parallels of Latitude: Imaginary horizontal circles running east-west parallel to the Equator that measure angular distance north or south.

front_prompt: Define 'Meridians of Longitude' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Meridians of Longitude: Imaginary vertical half-circles running pole-to-pole that measure angular distance east or west from the Prime Meridian.

front_prompt: Define 'Equator' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Equator: The zero-degree parallel of latitude (0°) that divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres.

front_prompt: Define 'Prime Meridian' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Prime Meridian: The reference meridian of 0° longitude passing through Greenwich, London, dividing Earth into Eastern and Western Hemispheres.

front_prompt: Define 'Madhya Rekhā' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Madhya Rekhā: The ancient Indian prime meridian passing through Ujjain (Ujjayinī), used by ancient astronomers like Varāhamihira.

front_prompt: Define 'Indian Standard Time (IST)' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Indian Standard Time (IST): The single standard time observed across India based on the 82.5° E meridian, set at GMT +5:30.

front_prompt: Define 'International Date Line' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: International Date Line: An imaginary line along approximately 180° longitude where crossing eastward subtracts a calendar day and crossing westward adds a day.

front_prompt: Define 'Torrid Zone' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Torrid Zone: The hot climatic region lying between the Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N) and Tropic of Capricorn (23.5° S).

front_prompt: Define 'Frigid Zone' in the context of Class 6 Social Science.
back_answer: Frigid Zone: The extremely cold regions near the poles beyond the Arctic Circle (66.5° N) and Antarctic Circle (66.5° S).
